# Brevrix (https://brevrix.com)

> Brevrix is a Web, DevOps & AI Automation Studio based in Bangladesh, serving founders and engineering teams worldwide.

## Core Expertise & Services
- **DevOps & Cloud Infrastructure**: Linux (Ubuntu, Debian, RHEL), Kubernetes (k8s, k3s, Helm), Docker, CI/CD (ArgoCD GitOps, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, Trivy security), Kong API Gateway, Harbor, WireGuard VPN.
- **Database Operations & Disaster Recovery**: PostgreSQL (pgBackRest, replication, PITR), MySQL, Redis caching, ClickHouse.
- **Web Development & Performance**: Ultra-fast Astro websites, WordPress speed optimization, Tailwind CSS, sub-50ms Cloudflare Pages edge deployment, 100/100 Core Web Vitals.
- **Server & Speed Audit ($249)**: 72-hour thorough audit of server security, Kubernetes posture, or WordPress/Astro performance with video walkthrough.
- **AI & Workflow Automation**: Self-hosted n8n workflows, Python automation, OpenAI/LLM API pipelines, computer vision.
- **Technical SEO & Performance**: Technical SEO, Core Web Vitals remediation, Generative Engine Optimization (GEO).
